title: Law to require moped safety info at point of sale
summary: This bill would require moped retailers to give buyers written materials about registration, inspection, insurance and traffic safety rules at the time of purchase. The Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, working with the Department of Transportation, would create these materials in English and other citywide languages. Retailers who fail to distribute them could face civil penalties ranging from $0 for a first violation up to $500 for a third or later violation.
